title: incident-bot: add contextual quicklinks to on-call autodiagnostics
author: Priya Patel
release_notes: Added contextual quicklinks to incident-bot autodiagnostics: runbook links, related SLOs, and quick remediation steps surfaced in on-call messages. No breaking changes.
description:
Motivation:
Surface contextual runbook and SLO quicklinks directly in the on-call autodiagnostics Slack messages generated by incident-bot. Operators frequently need the most relevant runbook, the owning SLO, and a short list of actions immediately after diagnostics are posted; surfacing these reduces time-to-recovery and handoffs between teams.

What this PR does (single summary string):
- Adds a quicklinks helper that synthesizes runbook links, primary SLO(s), and a short action list for a detected symptom.
- Integrates quicklinks into the existing autodiagnostics message flow (Slack and web UI anchors).
- Uses a TTL-cached metadata lookup to avoid extra blocking calls during high-throughput alerts.
- Adds unit + integration tests and a short docs page describing linking heuristics and configuration.

Checklist:
- [x] New helper + tests
- [x] Integration with outgoing Slack message templates
- [x] TTL cache (60s default) + metrics for cache hit/miss
- [x] Docs: oncall/runbooks.md updated with examples
- [x] Rollout notes: feature gated behind `ENABLE_QUICKLINKS` flag (off by default in prod)

Design notes and constraints:
- The quicklinks selection favors runbooks with explicit `oncall_quicklink: true` annotation, otherwise falls back to best-match by tag similarity (service, symptom, SLO owner).
- To keep latency predictable we batch metadata lookups and use an in-process LRU + expiry cache; external SLO-store calls are gated by a separate background refresher.
- We emit two new metrics: `incident_bot.quicklinks.cache_hit` and `incident_bot.quicklinks.selection_latency_ms` for monitoring.

Testing and validation:
- Unit tests cover selection heuristics and TTL behavior.
- Integration test stubs validate Slack formatting and presence of links in the message payload.
- Load test (local) shows <= 3ms extra median latency per autodiagnostics message at 500 RPS when cache is warm.

Related work:
- Builds on ENG-4110 (runbook metadata standardization) and SRE-119 (on-call workflow improvements).

Merge notes:
- Feature is behind gate `ENABLE_QUICKLINKS`; deploy with gate off, enable incrementally during canary.
